help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Film Roulette
help.gettingStartedDesc: Film Roulette is a free, no-signup movie discovery platform. Just roll the dice and find your perfect movie for tonight.
help.gs1Desc: Hit the big "🎲 Roll the Dice!" button on the home page to get a random movie recommendation instantly.
help.gs2Desc: Click the ❤️ heart icon on any movie card to save it to your Favourites list.
help.gs3Desc: Every movie you roll is automatically saved to your History. Access it from the menu anytime.
help.feat1Desc: Our algorithm picks a random movie from thousands in the TMDB database, filtered by your preferences.
help.feat2Desc: Use the search bar in the header to find any specific movie by title.
help.feat3Desc: Every movie card has a "Watch Trailer" button that loads the official YouTube trailer directly.
help.feat4Desc: Tap "Watch Movie" to stream via our embedded player. We automatically find the best available server.
help.filt1Desc: Filter by genre — Action, Comedy, Horror, Romance and more.
help.filt2Desc: Set a "From" and "To" year to discover classics or recent hits.
help.filt3Desc: Filter movies by their original language — English, Turkish, French and more.
help.filt4Desc: Only see movies above a minimum TMDB score — great for finding quality picks.
help.pl1Desc: Our player embeds movie streams from trusted third-party servers. No account needed.
help.pl2Desc: If the stream is not loading or buffering, you can easily switch to another streaming provider by clicking the 'Server 1', 'Server 2', etc. buttons located directly below the player frame.
help.pl3Desc: Your watch position is saved locally. When you reopen a movie and press Watch, it tries to resume from where you left off.
help.acc1Desc: Film Roulette works completely without signup. Your data stays on your device.
help.acc2Desc: Your History, Favourites and watch progress are stored in your browser's local storage — not on any server.
help.acc3Desc: To reset everything, simply clear your browser's site data or local storage for filmroulette.vercel.app.
help.faq1A: Yes, 100% free. No subscription, no ads, no account.
help.faq2A: Try changing the server using the "Change Server" button. Some movies may not be available on all servers.
help.faq3Q: Can I use it on mobile?
help.faq3A: Absolutely! The site is fully responsive. You can also install it as a mobile app — see the Mobile App section.
help.faq4Q: Where does the movie data come from?
help.faq4A: Movie metadata is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). Video streams come from third-party embed providers.
help.faq5Q: How do I report a bug?
help.faq5A: Contact the developer via the app's download page or social media.
